tooltips.stretch:

Histogram equalization — spreads intensity values
uniformly for maximum global contrast

applies.name: nothing touched: the lines as they opened
Equalize, then a line dragged: the lines win
Equalize, then Contrast Stretch: the stretch wins
Contrast Stretch, then CLAHE: CLAHE wins
CLAHE, then Clip changed: CLAHE again with the new clip
